# Bug Reporting User Flow

1. Open Business Central and the Thinknine extension.
2. Choose **Report a Bug**. Recording begins in one action.
3. Reproduce the problem. If BC shows an error, its observable text, details, and screenshot are captured when available. Silent functional problems are also supported.
4. Choose **Stop and open bug report**.
5. The local draft opens automatically and focuses Title when absent, otherwise Expected Result when absent.
6. Review the generated title and reproduction, then add what should have happened and any useful actual-result context.
7. Review the captured BC error and evidence. Expand **Technical details** only when needed.
8. Save, copy, or export the report locally. Optionally fetch telemetry or run explicitly consented AI analysis.
9. To create an external issue, open Issue Preview, inspect transmitted content, choose a configured destination, consent, and submit.

No BC error dialog is required. Missing telemetry, AI, or issue-provider configuration never blocks saving or exporting the report.
